title: Beautiful towels.
text: Beautiful towels.. Beautiful material. The printing is very clear and vibrant. Very nice size towels that Im thinking of using them as tablecloths for 2 of my little tables in my living room. I really like the thickness of these and the quality of the material. There were no loose stray threads hanging off anywhere.
